create_fixed_point_algorithm: create a FixedPoint algorithm instance for a mean-field game with optional softmax temperature
run_fixed_point_iteration: run a fixed point iteration to update policy and distribution via Banach-Picard convergence
get_fixed_point_policy: get the current policy from a FixedPoint algorithm after running iterations
get_fixed_point_distribution: get the mean-field distribution induced by the current FixedPoint policy
build_softmax_fixed_point: build a FixedPoint algorithm with softmax temperature for regularized policy updates
